name: Money Sent Receipt
description: Receipt emailed to the sender after a student-to-student money transfer
subject: Money Sent Receipt - £{amount} ({reference_number})
body_html:
💸 Money Sent Receipt

Dear {sender_name},

You have sent money from your Student Finance Account.

Transfer Receipt

Reference Number:{reference_number}
Date & Time:{transfer_date}
From Account:{sender_id}
Recipient:{recipient_name} ({recipient_id})
Reference:{reference}
Amount Sent:£{amount}

Account Summary

Previous Balance:£{balance_before}
Amount Sent:-£{amount}
New Balance:£{balance_after}

If you did not make this transfer, please contact the Finance Office immediately.

Best regards,
University Finance Department

This is an automated receipt. Please do not reply to this email.

sender_id.description: Student ID or username of the sender

recipient_id.description: Student ID or username of the recipient

amount.description: Amount sent, formatted to two decimal places

transfer_date.description: Date and time of the transfer
